title: DeviceRegistration
description: device -> server, a plain HTTP POST (not a WS message, no type discriminator — same family as notification-event.schema.json) made once, before the device's first WebSocket connection, to register the Keystore key pair it generated at first launch. public_key is the base64-encoded X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (SPKI) DER bytes of an EC (P-256) public key. The device_id is NOT chosen by the device: it is derived from the key — "dt_" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the SPKI DER bytes (test vectors: examples/device-id-vectors.json) — so nobody can register, or take over, another phone's id without its private key. The server derives it and returns it in the response. `device_id` in this request is therefore optional and deprecated: a device sends only `public_key`; if `device_id` is present it must equal the derived value or the request is rejected (400). Registering the same key again is idempotent (same id, no new secret). Key rotation is not supported: a new key is a new device_id.

device_id.description: Deprecated; send only public_key. If present it must equal the id derived from public_key.
